title: TALES reading in one long player, no gaps between sentences (manual until automated)

clauses.text: A TALES reading plays its sentences one after another with no cut or gap between them.

steps.do: Open TALES, choose a story and have it read aloud for at least two minutes. Listen to where one sentence ends and the next begins.
steps.expect: Each sentence follows the last without a cut-off word, a click or an audible gap. A short quiet lead-in at the very start is normal.

clauses.text: The reading ends cleanly: the last sentence finishes and nothing repeats or restarts.

steps.do: Let the reading run to its end.
steps.expect: The last sentence finishes, then the sound stops. No sentence repeats.

clauses.text: If the reading breaks up inside a sentence under load, the person says where (this part is not known yet).

steps.do: Start a reading and, while it plays, run another heavy task (for example a large file copy).
steps.expect: Either the reading stays smooth, or each break is noted with the sentence where it happened.
